note: Per-model regression baselines for `npm run eval` (roadmap R2, Layer B). The eval CLI reads the min pass for the running model and fails the run if a variant regresses below it. After an intentional improvement (better prompt, richer KB, more tasks), re-run the full eval and update these numbers with the new source note.

gpt-6-luna.source: three-way full eval 2026-10-17 — gpt-6-luna via OpenAI /v1/chat/completions, temp 0, seed 42, 10 runs/task. The endpoint forces reasoning_effort "none" for function tools, so this model is baselined with reasoning off — a Responses-API run (reasoning on) is a different configuration and should be re-baselined deliberately. Re-baselined: the 10-run config replaced the 2026-10-14 3-run baseline (20/33, 22/33). Three infra-hit (task, condition) pairs (hosted-connection stalls) were re-run and taken whole from the patch runs — the OpenAI seed is best-effort, not deterministic, so re-running a slot redraws the whole pair: kb-on double-settle-rejection + interleaved-payments from artifacts/eval/2026-10-18T00-16-01-gpt-6-luna.json, kb-off settle-moves-money from artifacts/eval/2026-10-18T00-31-44-gpt-6-luna.json. kb-content-off (86/110) deliberately NOT baselined — single measurement, per the re-baseline policy. Expect run-to-run spread of a few points on hosted re-runs (non-deterministic endpoint), not exact-count stability. Source report: artifacts/eval/2026-10-17T22-58-19-gpt-6-luna.json (330 attempts, full traces)
